data section string.description: A section "data" block declaring one NUL-terminated string

bss section variable.description: A section "bss" block declaring a zero-initialised global

data section constant.description: A section "data" block declaring an initialised scalar constant

exported procedure.description: export a procedure definition with no return type

exported procedure with parameters.description: export a procedure that takes typed parameters

main procedure.description: export main; terminating with mexit(0) as Cmm requires

foreign C call bound to a variable.description: A foreign "C" expression-form call assigning its result

ffi call.description: ffi is the stdc--.h shorthand for foreign "C"

import C symbol.description: Top-level import "C" declaration (C headers cannot be #included)

local declaration.description: Declare one or more locals (initialisers are not allowed in Cmm bodies)

memory read.description: Load a value of a given width from a computed address

memory write.description: Store a value of a given width to a computed address

switch.description: A multi-way branch (arms never fall through)

goto loop.description: The label + goto counting-loop idiom Cmm requires

jump (tail call).description: A non-returning tail call — nothing after it in the same block ever runs

prim operation.description: A primitive operation in the `prim %name(...)` form

bare primitive operation.description: A primitive operation in the bare `%name(...)` form

print a formatted value.description: printf-style output through the stdc--.h wrapper

print a string.description: puts-style output through the stdc--.h wrapper

exit.description: Terminate the program (required at the end of main)

Cmm boilerplate.description: The include header pair used by nearly every Cmm program

Cmm boilerplate with cmmath.description: Include triple; cmmath.h must come last because it #undefs mdiv

gmm build.description: Compile and link the current file with the gmm driver
